job.job_description:
We are looking for a motivated Frontend Developer to join our development team and work on modern web applications using Next.js, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS, FastAPI, and Python.

Key Responsibilities:

Develop responsive and user-friendly web interfaces using Next.js and TypeScript.
Convert UI/UX designs into functional and reusable frontend components.
Build clean, scalable, and maintainable application layouts using Tailwind CSS.
Integrate frontend applications with REST APIs developed using FastAPI and Python.
Handle API requests, form submissions, validation, loading states, and error messages.
Create reusable components, tables, dashboards, forms, modals, and navigation systems.
Ensure applications work properly across desktop, tablet, and mobile devices.
Identify and fix frontend bugs, performance issues, and browser compatibility problems.
Collaborate with UI/UX designers, backend developers, and other team members.
Use Git and GitHub for version control and code collaboration.
Maintain proper code structure, documentation, and development standards.
Participate in testing, deployment, and continuous improvement of applications.

Required Skills:

Basic knowledge of Next.js, React.js, and TypeScript.
Good understanding of HTML, CSS, JavaScript, and Tailwind CSS.
Basic knowledge of Python and FastAPI.
Understanding of REST API integration and JSON data handling.
Familiarity with Git, GitHub, npm, and VS Code.
Basic understanding of responsive design and component-based development.
Good problem-solving skills and willingness to learn new technologies.

Preferred Skills:

Basic knowledge of SQL or database concepts.
Familiarity with authentication, JWT, and role-based access systems.
Knowledge of deployment platforms such as Vercel, AWS, or similar services.
Personal, academic, internship, or freelance projects will be an advantage.

Eligibility:

Freshers are welcome to apply.
B.Tech, BCA, MCA, B.Sc. Computer Science, diploma holders, or candidates with relevant technical training may apply.
Candidates should have at least one academic or personal project to demonstrate their skills.



Disclaimer: This job posting has been aggregated from external source. Role details, content, and availability are subject to change. Applicants are advised to confirm the latest information directly on the company website before applying.
